title: A Dual-Encoder Contrastive Learning Model for Knowledge Tracing
authors: Yanhong Bai; Xingjiao Wu; Tingjiang Wei; Liang He
pdf_filename: A Dual-Encoder Contrastive Learning Model for Knowledge Tracing (DECKT).pdf
note: KT is central. Explicit question-concept bipartite graph with GAT; momentum dual-encoder contrastive learning with InfoNCE and graph-structure constraint. Meets Graph-Based and SSL criteria.

title: Dynamic Heterogeneous Graph Contrastive Networks for Knowledge Tracing
authors: Yehong Han; Hailiang Tang; Wenxiao Zhang; Lin Du; Jun Zhao; Minglai Shao
pdf_filename: Dynamic heterogeneous graph contrastive networks for knowledge tracing.pdf
note: KT is central. Uses temporal heterogeneous graphs, dynamic graph generation, and self-supervised heterogeneous graph contrastive embedding. Meets Graph-Based and SSL criteria.

title: Heterogeneous Graph Knowledge Tracing with Novel Contrastive View and Meta-Path Contexts
authors: Jie Liu; Zheng Guan; Xue Wang; Zhijun Yang
pdf_filename: Heterogeneous graph knowledge tracing with novel contrastive view and meta-path contexts.pdf
note: KT is central. Builds a heterogeneous information network with meta-path coarse/fine views and contrastive learning with graph augmentation and negative-sample selection. Meets Graph-Based and SSL criteria.

title: CoSKT: A Collaborative Self-Supervised Learning Method for Knowledge Tracing
authors: Chunyun Zhang; Hebo Ma; Chaoran Cui; Yumo Yao; Weiran Xu; Yunfeng Zhang; Yuling Ma
pdf_filename: CoSKT A Collaborative Self-Supervised Learning Method for Knowledge Tracing.pdf
note: KT is central. Self-supervised consistency/contrastive objective aligns common knowledge state from similar students with the target student's individual knowledge state. Meets SSL criterion.

title: Tracing Knowledge Instead of Patterns: Stable Knowledge Tracing with Diagnostic Transformer
authors: Yu Yin; Le Dai; Zhenya Huang; Shuanghong Shen; Fei Wang; Qi Liu; Enhong Chen; Xin Li
pdf_filename: Tracing Knowledge Instead of Patterns Stable Knowledge Tracing with Diagnostic Transformer.pdf
note: KT is central. DTransformer uses sequence augmentations (flip response, drop item, swap adjacent items) and contrastive loss over knowledge states from the same learner. Meets SSL criterion.

title: Self-Paced Contrastive Learning for Knowledge Tracing
authors: Huan Dai; Yue Yun; Yupei Zhang; Rui An; Wenxin Zhang; Xuequn Shang
pdf_filename: Self-paced contrastive learning for knowledge tracing.pdf
note: KT is central. Uses self-paced data augmentation and self-supervised contrastive learning with a contrastive loss balancing local/global samples; includes educationally informed skill-replacement augmentation. Meets SSL criterion.

title: Contrastive Learning Based on Bipartite Graphs for Interpretable Knowledge Tracing
authors: Kai Chen; Shun Mao; Qiwen Zheng; Yuncheng Jiang
pdf_filename: Contrastive Learning Based on Bipartite Graphs for Interpretable Knowledge Tracing.pdf
note: KT is central. Uses explicit exercise-concept bipartite graph plus intra-class graphs, graph augmentation, GNN/BGAT encoders, and InfoNCE-style contrastive learning. Meets Graph-Based and SSL criteria.
